name: evict by balancing a recency list against a frequency list
mechanism: keep two lists, one of items seen once recently and one of items seen more than once, plus ghost lists of what was recently evicted from each; a hit in a ghost list grows the corresponding list's target size, so the split between recency and frequency adapts to the workload
